name: Release

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - "v*"

jobs:
  build:
    strategy:
      matrix:
        include:
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            target: linux-x64
            archive_ext: tar.gz
          - os: macos-latest
            target: darwin-x64
            archive_ext: tar.gz
          - os: windows-latest
            target: windows-x64
            archive_ext: zip
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-action@stable
        with:
          toolchain: stable

      - name: Build release binary
        run: cd compiler && cargo build --release

      - name: Package (unix)
        if: runner.os != 'Windows'
        run: |
          mkdir -p dist
          cp compiler/target/release/zifer dist/
          cd dist && tar -czf ../zifer-${{ matrix.target }}.tar.gz zifer

      - name: Package (windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        run: |
          mkdir dist
          cp compiler/target/release/zifer.exe dist/
          Compress-Archive -Path dist/zifer.exe -DestinationPath zifer-${{ matrix.target }}.zip

      - name: Upload to Release
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
        with:
          files: zifer-${{ matrix.target }}.${{ matrix.archive_ext }}
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

  publish-vscode:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "20"
      - name: Publish extension
        run: |
          cd vscode-zifer
          npm install
          npx vsce publish -p ${{ secrets.VSCE_TOKEN }}
